newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy deficit would be 4.1 pct without measures.
newsitem.headline: Italy deficit would be 4.1 pct without measures.

text.p: Italy's public deficit to gross domestic product ratio would total 4.1 percent in 1998 if the government failed to make budgetary savings, a statement issued by the Prime Minister's office said.
The figures were made available at a news conference after the government approved a three-year economic strategy, called the DPEF, setting taxing and spending plans for the next three years.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi said next year's budget would cut 25 trillion lire off the deficit with the aim of reducing it to 2.8 percent of GDP in 1998, below the three percent ceiling required to qualify for European economic and monetary union.
